Get it by · Order in Notify me when in stock Notify me of updates Notify me when in stock More Details Find a Dealer Sound Clips Big Muff 2 the Limit Clean Blend Clarity Singing Sustain Sweeping Mids Fuzz Wah Fat Tone w Harmony Pedal Post Psych Lead w Phaser Menu Deluxe Big Muff Pi 2 | Deluxe Dual Op-Amp Fuzz Deluxe Big Muff Pi 2 quantity Find a Dealer Deluxe Big Muff Pi 2 DESCRIPTION The Deluxe Big Muff Pi is known as Electro-Harmonix’s most versatile Big Muff ever and now, the dual op-amp Big Muff 2 gets the same deluxe treatment for maxed-out fuzz flexibility. Expanded features like the WICKER switch, built-in noise gate, and footswitchable mids section make the Deluxe Big Muff Pi 2 a powerhouse of massive fuzz possibilities. The Deluxe Big Muff Pi 2 features the signature midrange grind of the original with the flexible EQ and virtually endless sustain expected in any Big Muff. Classic controls include VOLUME, TONE, AND SUSTAIN for control of overall output, EQ, and gain respectively. BLEND sets the mix of clean and dirty signals to balance ferocity with clarity while the adjustable GATE keeps unwanted noise under control. The 3-way WICKER switch opens up two levels of additional top-end filtering for a extra high-frequency brightness. The parametric mids section features its own footswitch, a Hi/Lo Q switch, and adjustable Frequency and Level controls that can be set to boost or cut mids over a wide frequency range. With an expression pedal or control voltage device connected to the EXP input, the MIDS FREQ is controlled by the external controller, turning the Deluxe Big Muff 2 into a wild fuzz wah. The Deluxe Bass Big Muff Pi 2 features a bypass footswitch with Latching/Momentary Action. Click the footswitch for normal latching functionality or press and hold the footswitch of a momentary burst of fuzz mayhem!
